nodes.label: vacinas table (SQLite, FK to bois)
nodes.rationale: Table was not created because the server started before the creation code was added to database.js.

nodes.label: requireAuth middleware
nodes.rationale: Looks up the user in the DB on every request and sets req.tenantId from the DB (checked against token tid), so profile, tenant change and suspension apply immediately; tenant never comes from body/query/header.

nodes.label: Composite FKs (tenant_id, id)
nodes.rationale: Makes cross-tenant references to farm/pasture/animal impossible at DB level even if a route forgets validation.

nodes.label: RLS enabled without policies
nodes.rationale: Supabase public REST API cannot access anything; backend uses a privileged role.

nodes.label: Shared schema with tenant_id model
nodes.rationale: One shared database/schema; every business table carries tenant_id; rule for new code: no query on a business table without tenant_id.
